events.label: Budget Night Cut-Off
events.description: Grandfathering cut-off for negative gearing. Properties under contract before this time retain full deductions.

events.label: Budget Tabled
events.description: Treasurer Jim Chalmers tables the 2026 Federal Budget in the House of Representatives.

events.label: Legislation Expected to be Introduced
events.description: Government expected to introduce enabling legislation for CGT and negative gearing changes into parliament.

events.label: Senate Committee Review
events.description: Senate Economics Committee expected to review tax legislation. Opposition may propose amendments.

events.label: Legislation Pass Deadline (Target)
events.description: Government aims to have legislation passed by end of 2026 to give taxpayers clarity before the 1 July 2027 start date.

events.label: New Rules Take Effect
events.description: CPI indexation replaces 50% CGT discount. 30% minimum tax floor commences. Negative gearing quarantine for post-budget established homes begins. Pre-1985 asset cost bases reset.
